description: Re-run a failed or cancelled workflow run at the SAME commit (same inputs, same PR merge preview) — the run page's Re-run. Gluecron re-runs every job of the run (per-job re-run does not exist yet); a successful or still-running run is refused. Joins an identical queued run instead of stacking another. Requires write access and 'repo' scope. Returns {runId, previousRunId, joinedExistingRun, url}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_rerun_failed_jobs
